data.summary: Resolve names to canonical Open Targets IDs

arguments.name: --entity
arguments.description: Restrict resolution to one entity type

arguments.name: --limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of candidates to return

arguments.name: --search-fallback
arguments.description: Fall back to search when mapIds yields no useful hit

notes: Direct-ID detection is conservative and entity-aware.
Resolution order is direct-id -> mapIds -> search.
Deterministic winner rule: top score >= 0.95 and margin >= 0.2.

Canonical direct-ID patterns: target=^ENSG\d{11}$, drug=^CHEMBL\d+$, disease=^(?:EFO|MONDO|Orphanet|OTAR|HP)_[A-Za-z0-9:.+-]+$, variant=^(?:chr)?(?:[1-9]|1\d|2[0-2]|X|Y|MT|M)_\d+_[ACGT]+_[ACGT]+$, study=^GCST\d+$
